title: Effect of Open-Label Placebos on Weight Loss and Hunger in Obesity
summary: Recent studies suggest that placebos can exert effects even when individuals are aware that they are receiving a placebo—that is, without any deception. For example, this effect has already been observed in studies investigating pain relief. The present study examines whether openly administered placebos can also influence weight loss.

interventions.name: Intervention group 1 will receive an open-label placebo twice daily for 4 weeks.
Intervention group 2 will receive a concealed placebo twice daily for 4 weeks.
Control group (no placebo, treatment as usual)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
BMI > 25
Exclusion criteria:
No known history of psychiatric, neurological, or endocrine disorders, or eating disorders (assessed via self-report)
